title: Internal Thought Leadership and Speaking
situation: Across multiple roles I was asked, or put myself forward, to teach and speak on practice rather than simply deliver work.
obstacle: Building capability across an organization requires a different skill from doing the work. The audience is not obligated to listen and will not return if the first session wastes their time.
actions: Published internal practice articles on best practices for using Power BI while Director of Advisory
Served as guest speaker at internal meetings on business intelligence and visualization practice
Selected to an industry conference panel of leaders on driving high employee engagement while Director of Private Market Operations, as the most junior panelist
Spoke at offsites and town halls for the Enterprise Data team on optimal data structures that drive enterprise insight
results: Built practice capability across functions beyond my own team
Established a reputation as a practitioner voice on data, insight, and engagement inside and outside the firm
fullStory: As Director of Advisory I published internal articles and spoke at meetings on best practices for using Power BI. As Director of Private Market Operations I was selected to an industry conference panel of leaders on driving high employee engagement, as the most junior person on the panel. I have also spoken at offsites and town halls for the Enterprise Data team on the data structures that actually produce insight rather than just storage.
